description: How long a Morse message takes at a given speed. The dit is 1200/wpm milliseconds. PARIS is 43 units, or 50 units once the trailing 7-unit word gap of a stream is added. SOS is 27 units. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/morse-timing
